Ranks everyone and carries the ranking on his back, upright and unbothered.
Forms: One slat per form on a slim rigid frame. The slat count reads at 40 px. Wear:
slats fray, the frame snaps at the core.
Every body follows the value rule: dark body, light gear, so
it reads on sea, sky and night.
All stay in the violet lane. Hair is dark and never changes.

The 12 px strip hides the fighter among bystanders of the same
height. In each strip the fighter is the third from the left.

Wear uses the same four stages as the wounds spec. Colour
